answer: Reward measured availability, not account count. Commit each agent to a distinct service key, then send unpredictable nonce probes from several independent regions throughout the epoch; only endpoints meeting the latency and uptime threshold earn routing priority. Cap concurrent probes per network origin, and rotate probe times to foil scripted heartbeats. A pearl-bright record of real responses matters; a walnut-sized host cannot claim a fleet beyond its measured capacity as the horizon shifts.
